meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **shaadi ke liye budget online sarees** lene hain to aap *simple but festive* options dekh sakte ho—jaise **organza, georgette, chiffon, silk-blend, aur light Banarasi/printed sarees**—kyunki inmein achha wedding look milta hai aur price bhi relatively manageable rehta hai. Meesho par wedding sarees **₹149 se** mil rahi hain, aur many options **₹299 se kam** bhi listed hain; budget-friendly shopping ke liye ye sabse low-cost starting point hai.[1]

Agar aap thoda better fabric aur finish chahte ho, to in budget ranges ko target karo:

- **Under ₹2,000**: Meesho, Amrut Fashion, aur Some budget collections—yahan simple wedding/guest sarees mil jaati hain.[1][10]
- **₹1,000–₹3,000**: Libas aur Manyavar/Mohey type collections—yahan **silk blend, organza, embroidered, aur ready-to-wear** styles milte hain.[2][20]
- **₹3,000–₹6,000**: Monamaar jaise stores mein wedding saree collection ka price range **Under ₹1999 se ₹4000+** tak hai, so yahan better festive look mil sakta hai.[14]
- **₹10,000+**: Nalli, Kankatala, Kalki, Tata CLiQ Luxury—ye mostly premium/bridal side par hain.[5][6][7][9]

**Best budget-friendly saree types for shaadi:**
- **Silk blend saree**: traditional look, heavy feel ke bina.[2][20]
- **Organza saree**: lightweight aur classy, guest wear ke liye strong choice.[20]
- **Georgette/chiffon saree**: comfortable aur easy-to-carry.[17]
- **Printed wedding saree with light work**: low budget mein festive appearance.[1][2]
- **Simple Banarasi-inspired saree**: bridal guest ya small functions ke liye achhi.[18][20]

**Agar aap bride ho**:
- Budget mein **simple silk-blend ya light Banarasi-style saree** best rahegi; Meesho par affordable bridal options listed hain, aur Libas/Mohey par ₹1,499–₹17,999 tak options milte hain.[1][2][20]
- Agar main reception/engagement look chahiye, to **organza with embroidery** ya **light zari work** better hota hai.[9][20]

**Agar aap guest ho**:
- **Printed silk blend**, **georgette**, ya **organza** saree le lo—ye budget mein bhi elegant lagti hain aur repeat wear bhi ho jaati hain.[2][17][20]

Aap chaaho to main aapke **exact budget** ke hisaab se 3 categories bana doon:
**under ₹1000**, **₹1000–₹3000**, aur **₹3000–₹7000** — aur har category mein best saree type bhi suggest kar doon.
